validators.name: indaba-lint
validators.title: Indaba authority lint (IND-1..4 + palette discipline)
validators.notes: Pack-local validator (no snapshot repo). Scans .css/.html for square corners (IND-1), off-palette colours and pure black (IND-2/3), and status pills without text (IND-4). Report shape: findings[{rule,severity,file,line,message,excerpt,fix}], counts, by_rule, score.
